news_risk: No adverse media or regulator action found in the sources reachable. Only negative-news-adjacent item: an NGT order of 29.08.2022 (suo motu on a Times of India report) mentions that mixed solvent supplied by M/s Ami Life Sciences, Vadodara was being distilled in a reactor at the time of an explosion at a third-party facility; the company is referenced as supplier, not as a party. No GST/SEBI/RBI/ED/IT enforcement action found in public sources. Note: general web search engines were unavailable/blocked during this check (searx connection refused, Google 429, Bing ignored exact-phrase queries), so absence of news is based on Indian Kanoon and OpenSanctions only - not an exhaustive media sweep.
rf_supply: No evidence found. No record of supplies to Russia or CIS located in any reachable source. Not confirmed either way - null.
note: Risk-only check as of 2026-11-26. Sanctions: OpenSanctions consolidated dataset (OFAC SDN, UN, EU, UK, BIS and others; data current 2026-11-26) returned 'No matching entities were found' for both 'AMI Life Sciences' and 'AMI Lifesciences' - no sanctions exposure identified. Court cases: multiple tax/excise matters before ITAT Ahmedabad and CESTAT Ahmedabad (2017-2025), all routine tax litigation, company appears as appellant/respondent; plus one NGT order (29.08.2022) where the company is mentioned only as a solvent supplier in an accident narrative, not as a party. Per project rules these are NOT rejection grounds - noted neutrally: 'есть сложности' (tax litigation history). Credit rating: null - no public rating found (company is not a rated large borrower; CRISIL/ICRA/CARE public pages not reachable/not found). RF/CIS supply: no evidence, null. Caveat: search infrastructure was partly unavailable (searx down, Google 429, Bing phrase search ineffective, ZaubaCorp/Tofler blocked 403), so this is a best-effort negative finding, not a certified clean bill. No CIN/PAN/registration data was researched per role scope.
